# S2.2 — Variant host: `subprocess_confined` plugins behind `plugin_abi/1`, host callbacks, V1–V6, `GuardVerdict`, `requests→Permission+ContainmentPolicy`, protocol/isolation/package suites, first packaged variant (R-2.12.2)

**Spec:** `spec/CANONICAL_SPEC.md` §8.4 (`R-2.12.2` Stage-2 slice)
**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/033_S2.2__variant-host.md`
**Requirement ids stamped:** **R-2.12.2** (AC-R-2.12.2-{3–7,13})
**Base:** `svitali/harnessharness-s2.1` (stacked) · **Stage:** 2 ·
**Live stage:** offline-only (Seatbelt lane live where `sandbox-exec`
exists)

## Summary

Third-party variants now run **out of process, confined**: the host
spawns the plugin through `hh-helper` (Seatbelt under
`local_sandboxed`), hands it exactly one AF_UNIX ABI channel, and speaks
`plugin_abi/1` over it. A plugin's only reach is contract operations
plus the closed `HostCallback` set — mediated, grant-checked, and
ledgered.

### `crates/hh-varhost` (new crate)

- `channel` — `AbiEnvelope` codec over NDJSON: schema-hash + max-frame
  enforcement, strict sequence validation, typed `ChannelError`s;
  `SocketIo` (accepted stream forced blocking) and `MemIo` lanes share
  one screening path.
- `screen` — V1–V6 inbound screening: forged host-direction verbs,
  `InboundAuthority` (Permission/authority/taint/risk-class claims),
  `MonitorClaim`, `StampForgery`, `UnexpectedVerb`, unawaited messages;
  every plugin output re-stamped `origin = tool:<extension_id>`,
  `authority = external`, `taint = [extension_id]`.
- `lower` — `requests ∩ cap → PermissionRecord` (issuer = sealing
  principal, `delegable: false`, budget preserved in constraints) +
  `ContainmentPolicy` (`fs.read = package_root ∪ fs_roots`, `fs.exec`,
  `net.mode = none`, ABI socket as sole `unix_sockets.allow`, cleared
  env + declared `env_keys` projection); unenforceable claims (egress,
  budget metering) recorded as honest `losses`.
- `session` — helper spawn → exec → hello (ABI version + plugin
  `version_id` + content pin checks); bind/invoke/stream/cancel/unbind/
  guard/callback pumps; typed `PluginCrashed`/`InvocationTimeout`/
  `SessionDetached`/protocol errors; detached sessions refuse all ops.
- `host` — `VariantHost` API over typed ports; ledgered
  `lifecycle.component.{bound,invoked}`, `security.extension.{loaded,
  violation}`, `security.egress.{requested,allowed,refused}`,
  `control.guard.fired`, `action.effect.unknown`.
- `package` — `PluginManifest/1` load: package-rooted executable paths,
  locator-path refusal, content-pin verify (`PinMismatch`), explicit
  `seal()` — never a silent re-seal.

### `GuardVerdict` at the Stage-1 decision points

Typed `{pass, ask, annotate, deny, propose_replacement}` meet:
`allow` or a rewritten verdict → `AuthorityCrossing`; timed-out required
guard → `deny`, optional → `no_decision→pass`; `propose_replacement`
mints a fresh `effect_id` + `derived_from`. Guards cannot propose
effects.

### Plugin side

- `hh-plugin-fixture` — the shared plugin runtime (hello/handshake, op
  dispatch, callbacks, streams, guard replies, conformance runner) plus
  fixture modes: null / hostile (`violate:*`) / guard / crash /
  echo / stub-per-class; unknown ops → `AbiError::UnhandledOperation`.
- `hh-compact-evict-oldest` — first packaged first-party variant
  (`compaction_strategy`, `evict` op, deterministic, no model call);
  `plugins/hh-compact-evict-oldest/plugin.manifest.json` is the
  unsealed template — `seal` pins the built binary at pack time.

### Supporting halves

- `hh-helper`: `env_clear` on exec; seatbelt `unix_sockets.allow`
  emitted as `remote unix-socket` **regex** filters (literal forms never
  match on macOS — verified by the allow/deny probes); canonicalized
  paths in SBPL profiles (`/var`→`/private/var`); accept() nonblocking
  so deadlines hold.
- `hh-ledger`: `security.extension.violation` + `control.guard.fired`
  classes; `ScopeKind::ComponentCall` + `component_call_id` field.
- `hh-registry`: `compaction_strategy` ClassRecord + `evict` contract
  suite; corpus registration; `hh-assembly` catalog row.
- `scripts/check-removability.sh`: extension-tier edge-freedom check —
  no base crate may gain a build-dep edge into `hh-varhost` /
  `hh-plugin-fixture` / `hh-compact-evict-oldest`.
